items.difficulty_reason: The proof is the finite-type twin of the local-finite-presentation descent argument: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma for local finite type; the property is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z', the latter because Z' \times_Z U is \'etale over Z' \times_Z X), and the fpqc descent lemma for schemes concludes. The double use of the locality lemma and the final descent are the substance.
